messages:
customer-jira: Hi team — user reports streaming stops ~30s in Safari. EventSource connection shows initial data, then 304 from CDN and client reconnects repeatedly, final output is truncated. Happening across multiple customers behind our edge.
support-engineer-tina: Thanks — can you paste the request/response headers and a short repro? Is auth via Bearer header or cookie?
customer-jira: Bearer token in Authorization header. Repro steps: open page, start SSE, after ~30s partial chunk, browser shows closed, then reconnect loop. We attached HAR and console:
- Request: GET /v1/stream?model=wizard HTTP/1.1
- Response sequence: 200 (chunked) -> 304 from edge -> EventSource stutters

support-engineer-tina: Got it. Preliminary thought: CDN might return 304 for SSE preflight/if-modified, which can close underlying connection in some browsers. Also Safari has weird EventSource preflight/cache behavior. Can you confirm edge cache config (Cache-Control, Vary) for that path?
customer-jira: Edge headers in HAR:
"cache-control: public, max-age=60"
"vary: Accept-Encoding"
No Vary: Authorization present.
support-engineer-tina: That stands out — streaming endpoints must not be cached. 304s are problematic for chunked streams. Workaround: set Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate and remove caching at edge for /v1/stream. Also need Vary: Authorization if you rely on auth header for cache key.
eng-frontend-omar: Confirming: Safari (WebKit) sometimes converts 304 into connection end for EventSource. Also if Authorization is stripped at CDN or not included in cache key, edge may respond with cached 304. Please try disabling edge caching for the SSE path and re-test.
cdn-team-sam: We see requests hitting our edge with Authorization stripped by default cache key rules. If resource marked public, our edge may serve 304 from origin metadata. We can add a rule to bypass cache for paths matching /v1/stream and forward Authorization header. Are we ok to patch that quickly?
support-engineer-tina: Yes please. Meanwhile can the client use a short-lived query token as fallback? Note: query tokens may be cached in logs so watch security.
support-bot: Created internal ticket REDW-8342 and assigned to cdn-team-sam and eng-frontend-omar. Severity: P2. Links: https://redwood.internal/REDW-8342
eng-sre-lee: Adding that sometimes proxy + service-worker combos in Safari replay a cached response on reconnect. If customers have a service worker on the page, ask them to disable it for repro.
customer-jira: No service worker in the app. We tested with a direct load + private window.
support-engineer-tina: Can you run a curl mimic to see if the edge returns 304 for the same Authorization header? Example:

curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=wizard\"

Observe headers and whether the connection stays open. If curl sees 200 chunked then 304 after ~30s, that matches.
customer-jira: Ran curl — saw 200 then a short keepalive, then a 304 and connection close. I can share output.
support-engineer-tina: Ok that nails it. Short-term mitigation: set response headers for SSE from origin:

Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate
Pragma: no-cache
Expires: 0
Vary: Authorization

and make sure edge rule forwards Authorization and does not return cached 304 for that route.
eng-frontend-omar: Also recommend sending a small heartbeat comment from server every 15s like ": heartbeat\n\n" to keep some browsers happy. But this doesn't fix 304s from edge.
cdn-team-sam: I've applied a bypass rule on staging edge for /v1/stream to forward Authorization and disable caching. Please retest and paste new curl output.
customer-jira: Retested on staging — streaming persists, no 304, Safari stays connected, full output received. Thanks.
support-engineer-tina: Great. We'll push a production edge rule and update server to emit SSE headers and heartbeat by default. Eng-frontend to coordinate rollout.
eng-frontend-omar: I'll add header changes to the streaming handler and a compatibility note in docs about Safari + CDN. Also include repro steps and example curl in support KB.
support-bot: Production edge rule rollout scheduled in 30m under REDW-8342. Will update thread.
cdn-team-sam: Production rollout done. Verified responses show Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Authorization for /v1/stream. No 304s observed in logs.
customer-jira: Confirmed production fix — all affected customers report streams restored. Closing from our side.
support-engineer-tina: Marking resolved. Follow-ups: docs KB, add automatic header for SSE endpoints, and add monitoring alert if edge returns 3xx for streaming routes.
eng-sre-lee: I'll create an alert for any 3xx/304 responses on routes tagged as streaming. Ticket REDW-8343 created.
support-engineer-tina: Excellent. If anyone sees recurrence ping this thread or REDW-8342/8343.
